name: Critical Path Method
excerpt: The Critical Path Method is used to determine the shortest project duration.
notes: The Critical Path Method identifies critical activities with zero slack that cannot be delayed without affecting the project completion date. It involves two passes through the project network: one forward and one backward.
context_summary:
- Used to determine the shortest project duration.
- Identifies critical activities with zero slack.
- Involves two passes through the project network: forward and backward.
